en.headline: Government records HK$16.2 billion surplus in first six months of fiscal year
en.dek: The surplus for April to September was driven mainly by Silver Bonds proceeds; fiscal reserves stood at HK$681.7 billion at the end of September.
body: The government on Friday announced that it recorded a surplus of HK$16.2 billion for the six months ended 30 September 2026.

Expenditure for the period amounted to HK$373.1 billion and revenue to HK$271.8 billion. After taking into account HK$131 billion received from the issuance of government bonds and the repayment of HK$13.5 billion in principal, the result was a surplus. Fiscal reserves stood at HK$681.7 billion as at 30 September.

A government spokesman said the surplus was mainly due to proceeds from the issuance of Silver Bonds. Based on past patterns, major revenue items such as salaries tax and profits tax are mostly received towards the end of a financial year.
The figures cover the general revenue account and eight funds, including the Capital Works Reserve Fund and the Land Fund.

zh.headline: 政府本財政年度首六個月錄得162億元盈餘
zh.dek: 四月至九月盈餘主要來自發行銀色債券所得收入；截至九月底財政儲備為6817億元。
body: 政府周五公布，截至2026年9月30日止的首六個月錄得162億港元盈餘。
期內開支3731億元、收入2718億元。計入發行政府債券所得1310億元及償還政府債券本金135億元後，錄得盈餘。截至9月底，財政儲備為6817億元。
政府發言人表示，盈餘主要由於發行銀色債券所得收入。根據以往收款模式，薪俸稅及利得稅等主要收入大多在財政年度後期收取。
有關數字涵蓋政府一般收入帳目及八個基金，包括基本工程儲備基金及土地基金等。
